111:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Right then, time to hustle again today... business, business! Not that I'll be babysitting Blondie, though...」

111:t_10:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What is that supposed to mean, a charm!?」

112:t_000:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$ピーターソン$$ Base is in sight!」

112:t_000:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Just as expected, the defense line isn't up yet.」

112:t_000:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Don't let your guard down. Something is going to happen in this battle... I'm sure of it...」

112:t_000:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(The $$νガンダム$$ and the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ invasion... And $$ピーターソン$$ Base falling far too easily... If my guess is right...)

112:t_001:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That $$ヤクト・ドーガ$$...! Is that $$ギュネイ$$!?」

112:t_001:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ$$... And $c, too...」

112:t_001:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Why did $$ネオ・ジオン$$ come down to Earth!?」

112:t_001:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, begin the attack! With a force this small, we can retake the base on our own!」

112:t_001:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ギュネイ$$'s confusion and anger... There's definitely something going on...)

112:t_002:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain...! A force is approaching us!」

112:t_002:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ reinforcements!?」

112:t_003:1.en:
$$ファ$$
「They came to back us up, didn't they.」

112:t_004:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The attack came from the $$ＧＮ－ＸⅣ$$! It was not friendly fire; it is assessed that they targeted this ship from the start!」

112:t_004:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Is that a unit the enemy captured...!?」

112:t_004:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I don't think that's it.」

112:t_004:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you saying part of the $$地球連邦軍$$ sided with $$ネオ・ジオン$$...!?」

112:t_004:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「No...! The ones they've joined hands with aren't $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

112:t_004:7.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「We've confirmed more units approaching!」

112:t_005:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「All units, scatter! From here on we will conduct operations jointly with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the $$新地球皇国$$!」

112:t_005:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Tch...! Not just $$ネオ・ジオン$$, even part of the Federation has teamed up with the $$サイデリアル$$!」

112:t_005:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Has $$ネオ・ジオン$$ really joined hands with the $$サイデリアル$$!?」

112:t_005:12.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'm the commander of this operation! Follow orders!」

112:t_005:14.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Tch... What is he planning to do...」

112:t_006:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What are you up to, $$ギュネイ$$?」

112:t_006:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Get in the $$ガンダム$$, $$アムロ・レイ$$.」

112:t_006:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I've already sent the machine's position. Hurry.」

112:t_006:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「There's no point in fighting a pathetic mobile suit and winning! Hurry up!」

112:t_006:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...All right. I'll play along with your intent.」

112:t_007:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Follow me, $$アムロ・レイ$$.」

112:t_008:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Keep out of this, $$カミーユ$$. This is something I have to settle for myself.」

112:t_008:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$... In the end, the Colonel chose to fight alongside you rather than as $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s $$赤い彗星$$.」

112:t_008:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That's why I'll defeat you...! And I'll show that I can surpass the Colonel!」

112:t_008:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I have no intention of being anyone's stepping stone...! There's still something I have to do!」

112:t_008:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「All units, begin the attack! I'll take care of $$アムロ・レイ$$ myself!」

112:t_008:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「Return fire! $$ネオ・ジオン$$, the $$連邦軍$$, the $$サイデリアル$$, all of them are enemies!」

112:t_008:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$! I'm leaving $$ギュネイ$$ to you!」

112:t_008:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Come on, $$ギュネイ$$. I'll take $$シャア$$'s place and be your opponent...!)

112:t_009:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「If the enemy commander $$ギュネイ・ガス$$ hadn't made a misjudgment out of pride, we would not have won this victory.」

112:t_009:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Pride, huh... ...So that guy was still human after all...」

112:t_009:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ネオ・ジオン$$, having lost $$シャア$$... Where will they go from here...)

112:t_010:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop, $$ギュネイ$$! Do you really think $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has a future after teaming up with the $$サイデリアル$$!?」

112:t_010:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up, $$カミーユ$$! I don't need you to tell me that!」

112:t_010:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then come with us! You fought us once, so you should know what you have to do!」

112:t_010:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm sure Colonel $$シャア$$ wants that too!」

112:t_010:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass that man...! And with that power, the Spacenoids...!」

112:t_010:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Get out of my way, $$カミーユ$$! The one I'm fighting right now is $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

112:t_011:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn...! Is this as far as I go!?」

112:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wait, $$ギュネイ$$! I want to talk with you!」

112:t_011:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I have nothing to say to you people! I am... $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」
